source.title: Guidelines for Competency Based Postgraduate Training Programme for MD in Psychiatry (revised)

requirements.label: Log book signed by the authorized teacher and Head of Department
requirements.quote: Each student must be asked to present a specified number of cases for clinical discussion, perform procedures/present seminars/review articles from various journals in inter-unit/interdepartmental teaching sessions. They should be entered in a Log Book and signed by the authorized teacher and Head of Department.

requirements.label: Cases presented for clinical discussion
requirements.quote: Each student must be asked to present a specified number of cases for clinical discussion…
requirements.note: 'a specified number' — specified by the department. Counted, never targeted.

requirements.label: Seminars / review articles presented
requirements.quote: …present seminars/review articles from various journals in inter-unit/interdepartmental teaching sessions.

requirements.label: Intra- and inter-departmental meetings
requirements.quote: There should be intra - and inter - departmental meetings for discussing the uncommon / interesting medical problems.

proceduresNote: No procedure counts in the MD Psychiatry guidelines.
disclaimer: Requirements are traced to the NMC source named above. A requirement with target null is one the source mandates WITHOUT giving a number — it is counted, never scored against an invented target. This pack does not certify compliance; see NMC_PG_LOGBOOK_REQUIREMENTS.md.
